scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run build -w shared && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
